# Skinning and shared gathering interfaces — GT-S source-authoring verdict

**Audience: internal conference record. Status: finite source/interface authoring directions, not exact operational-card approval.**

This verdict covers **all 43 Skinning originals: recipe-507–545 and recipe-676–679**, including all twelve numeric/prose omissions and all five physical families. The source allocation is **28 public, two restricted and thirteen Director-only**. **Zero cards are promoted.** Reviewed recipe totals remain **392/687, with 295 remaining; public 251/433, with 182 remaining**. All 128 gathering-tool cards remain pending exact review.

## Evidence, precedence and reconciliation

Evidence references below identify material supplied in this conference:

**A1:** Part A, `CRAFTING_HARVEST_PLAYTEST.md`: credentials, checks, finite manifests, size times/yields, partial forfeiture, preservation, crafting quality, material identity and dismantling. **A2:** Part A’s trade reference, equipment/body guides, Core task resolution and creature-lifecycle excerpts. **A3:** Part A’s completed Fishing guide, especially first-capture history, material chronology, actual custody and the harvest boundary. **B1:** Part B’s shared evidence, GT-01–32 and exact equipment/component references. **C1:** Part C’s complete COMMON/overrides and structural register. **C2:** Part C’s 28 complete six-paragraph public-book bindings. **M:** the preceding GT-M01–18 Mining source verdict.

C1 names mechanical source SHA-256 `32b2bf00c28584ad259c343bc5b961126d25078c094444c05bf3caf0c9edda5e`; C2 names book SHA-256 `38eac505991a944ea557afa27751f510f773744734dc7a8e84c52b9bf7dcb099`. These are supplied source identifiers, not hashes independently recomputed from those books in this response. Arithmetic below is derived from the supplied fields and the explicitly new body references; no local report is relabeled as an independent source-file, runtime or campaign-fact verification.

**No earlier GT-M decision is rescinded.** This verdict explicitly adopts the same bounded approaches to non-artisan credentials, ordered bodies, source-preserving discrepancies, independent effect comparisons and historical state. It does **not** import Mining’s sixty-minute node procedure, mineral units, deposit renewal or mineral-preparation attribute into carcass harvesting.

Three additions require explicit reconciliation rather than silent inheritance: **Skinning’s own critical-only extraYield1 overlay; a separate hide/scale preparation step; and a narrowly defined preservation-check scope for Tanning Tools/Preservation Kits.** GT-S09 also states a new default for untreated scales/chitin and its compatible mundane treatment. Those are Skinning authoring completions, not changes to Mining’s preservation exclusion. GT-S06 adds a finite cross-trade reserve-partition rule without reopening Fishing’s first evaluation.

Every **NEW** provision below is an authoring completion. Preserve every original source object, duplicate occurrence, absent/null field, legacy name/effect, resultItem value, source status, needsReview flag, discovery requirement, private guidance and book paragraph. Operational fields must state their provenance separately.

## GT-S01 — All printed effects and all twelve omissions

**Affected: all 43 Skinning recipes. Sources: C1–C2.**

| Group | Exact recipes | Printed bonus | Quality clause | Additional ordinary-part entitlement |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| A | 507–531, 677, 678 | +1 Skinning | None | Zero |
| B | 532–541, 676, 679 | +2 Skinning | One successful hide/scale harvest quality step | **NEW:** up to one real eligible reserve unit, only on Critical Success |
| C | 542–545 | +3 Skinning | One successful hide/scale harvest quality step | Printed two additional usable parts, only on Critical Success |

The split is **27 A / 12 B / 4 C**. All recipe numbers in tables carry the `recipe-` prefix.

**Explicit individual omission dispositions:**

| Recipe | Visibility | Disposition of both original extraYield1 fields |
|---|---|---|
| 532 | restricted | Preserve; activate through NEW critical-only one-reserve-unit overlay |
| 533 | Director-only | Same explicit disposition |
| 534 | Director-only | Same explicit disposition |
| 535 | restricted | Same explicit disposition |
| 536 | Director-only | Same explicit disposition |
| 537 | Director-only | Same explicit disposition |
| 538 | Director-only | Same explicit disposition |
| 539 | Director-only | Same explicit disposition |
| 540 | Director-only | Same explicit disposition |
| 541 | Director-only | Same explicit disposition |
| 676 | public | Same explicit disposition, disclosed in its public operational text |
| 679 | Director-only | Same explicit disposition |

For each, retain the source prose that does **not** print yield. Do not claim it originally said “critical success.” This independently adopts the same bounded trigger selected for Mining, now after reviewing Skinning’s actual originals. An ordinary Success grants **no additional part** under either B or C. Failure/Critical Failure grants neither item yield nor item quality. All quality/extraYield clauses are **extraction-only**; a qualifying preservation check receives only its permitted numerical bonus.

**NEW interpretation:** the quality clause affects **one eligible ordinary hide/scale unit in one successful extraction attempt**, not every unit/category or all material from that species. It is reusable on other genuinely lawful, unresolved bodies, not a lifetime charge or a daily-use pool. The already-resolved body cannot be worked again to obtain another award.

The additional-part clause may recover an ordinary animal-part category other than hide/scale **only when the chosen Skinning procedure and actual tool role genuinely support it**. The quality step remains hide/scale-only. A specialized Scale Remover does not gain organ extraction from its ingredient list or from the generic word “parts.”

## GT-S02 — Credentials, tasks and effect arbitration

**Affected: all 43 recipes. Sources: A1–A2, M; Skinning-specific predicates below are NEW.**

Use **DEX or WIS**, chosen before the task, with the actual **non-artisan Skinner’s-tools credential**. Add PB once when trained, or the applicable replacing expertise contribution. Never add numerical trade level. **NEW ordinary-gathering binding:** untrained generic extraction uses no tool PB and has disadvantage; it has no recipe-level/formula gate. Actual tools, lawful access and physical possibility remain mandatory.

A novice may legitimately use a high-level finished tool under their own training terms; buying it gives no proficiency, formula, research result or creation eligibility. Artisan-only proficiency choices cannot select Skinner’s tools. Forge Dwarf’s artisan creation time/quality benefits apply to none of these Skinning creations or restoration tasks.

**Eligible magical check bonuses:** compatible ordinary animal-part extraction, including an independently authorized equivalent source procedure using Skinning; and **only T/P families** on the separately governed hide/compatible-scale preservation procedure in GT-S09. Physical roles and work windows must qualify.

**Excluded:** creature-type identification, Medicine diagnosis/treatment, knowledge checks, hunting/capture, recipe creation, formula research/copying, repair/reconstruction, leather/armor manufacture, tanning as a manufacturing process, post-harvest surface preparation, dismantling, valuation, combat and general Forage. Tool ownership or a task’s name supplies no exception. The source crafting specialty remains crafting-work-order scoped.

**NEW Skinning-only comparison families:** `equipment.skinning-task-enhancement` uses the strongest independently eligible Skinning recipe bonus once; `equipment.skinning-extra-recovery` uses the strongest eligible critical-only allowance once; `equipment.skinning-quality-step` permits at most one eligible step on one unit. These are three independent comparisons, not three additive item totals or a universal strongest-modifier rule.

An extraction lead may have **one trained eligible assistant for +1**, working the same required extraction time. The assistant’s tool magic does not become the lead’s bonus or extra yield, and their hands do not substitute for the lead’s. Preservation has **no assistants**, as retained in A1. Creation uses each recipe’s separate assistant cap.

Actual class, spell, facility and other item modifiers must meet their own reviewed predicates and stacking rules. Do not infer a Leatherworking, Tailoring, Fishing or jewel bonus from a shared word. Do not silently move a competing effect to a new family. A genuinely unprovided source interaction remains for the final joint source check, not an invented universal rule.

## GT-S03 — Five complete physical output models

**Affected: exact family sets below. All body prices, dimensions and internal contents are NEW except the explicitly reused Small-knife value/mass.**

Every output is a **durable magical nonartifact tool**, Standard equipment grade, without attunement, RP, charges, concentration or separate magic-activation Action. There is no automatic Large scaling. Real hands, fit, weight, space, support and tissue/material compatibility still govern.

| Code / family | Exact recipes | Mundane body gp / empty lb | Ordinary HP / structural AC |
|---|---|---|---|
| K — Skinning Knife | 508, 514, 521, 522, 528, 530, 533, 536, 538 | **1 gp / 0.25 lb** | 5 / 19 |
| H — Hide Scraper | 510, 511, 515, 518, 523, 525, 526, 531, 532, 537, 541, 544, 678 | **1 gp / 1 lb** | 5 / 19 |
| R — Scale Remover | 513, 517, 519, 534, 535, 540, 543, 545, 677 | **2 gp / 1 lb** | 5 / 19 |
| T — Tanning Tools | 507, 512, 520, 524, 539, 542, 679 | **8 gp / 8 lb** | 5 / 15 |
| P — Preservation Kit | 509, 516, 527, 529, 676 | **10 gp / 6 lb** | 5 / 19 |

**K:** an eight-inch tool with four-inch steel blade, continuous tang and fitted grip. Reuse the reviewed Small knife’s 1-gp/0.25-lb reference only for a physically matching specimen; the skinning shape is a NEW binding. One hand manipulates it and the other controls the supported work. Original blade/tang is primary; a compatible grip may be replaced. No sheath or sample container is included. It is not automatically a dagger, magical weapon or surgical permission.

**H:** a twelve-inch two-hand scraper with a four-inch steel working edge/bar and two grips. Both hands operate it on an actual supported hide or compatible plate/backing. Original steel working bar/blade is primary; grips and minor fittings may be replaced. It provides no rack, sample storage, force multiplier or automatic ability to separate an incompatible carapace.

**R:** a ten-by-two-by-one-inch guarded manual rake/lifter, with steel working head/spine and grip. One hand operates it and the other steadies the supported specimen. Original head/spine is primary; grip and minor fittings may be replaced. It lifts compatible scales/plates along actually separable attachments. It is not a drill, universal shell opener, net, weapon, restraint or container.

**T:** a folding manual frame, **26 × 26 × 4 inches deployed**, **26 × 4 × 4 inches packed**, with a **24 × 24-inch clear supported work area**. Maximum supported workpiece/consumable load: **10 lb**, with actual thickness up to **2 inches** where retained in the frame. No compression is granted. Contents: frame rails/crossbars 4 lb, draw scraper 1 lb, blunt slicker 0.5 lb, four clamps 1 lb total, support straps/feet 1 lb and fitted roll 0.5 lb: **8 lb total**.

T needs actual stable support and two manipulating hands. It supports controlled hide/backing separation and preparation; a compatible sheet of scales/chitin can qualify through its actual physical method. It is not a vat, full-body hoist, preservation effect, tent or automatically supplied Harvesting Rack. Original frame rails/crossbars and draw-scraper working blade are primary. Compatible clamps, straps, grips, slicker and roll are replaceable ordinary members; the complete required set must still exist for magical function. A frame’s ten-pound limit never admits a whole Mammoth by name.

**P:** a lidded steel receiving/treatment box, **16 × 10 × 6 inches outside**, with a dedicated **12 × 8 × 4-inch specimen chamber** and separate fitted implement wells. Chamber contents must satisfy **10 lb and 0.20 ft³**, actual shape, closure and material compatibility. Empty contents: box/lid 4 lb, tongs 0.5 lb, spreading spatula 0.5 lb, brush 0.25 lb, measuring scoop 0.25 lb, reusable liner 0.5 lb: **6 lb total**.

P supports hands-on receiving, controlled separation with its implements where appropriate, and treatment of already lawfully removed parts. Both hands are committed to its nominated work. The original box shell/lid and tongs are primary; spatula, brush, scoop, liner and minor closures may be replaced compatibly. It supplies no knife, bone saw, salt, oil, clean-water allotment, fresh packing, fuel, refrigeration or magical containment. Its box alone does not pause decay. Larger actual receiving containers can support a compatible workflow, but do not enlarge this box or eliminate its required actual use.

Steel load-bearing models use structural AC19; T’s wooden frame uses AC15. A separately modeled constituent retains its actual material defenses. Whole-item HP is not cloned onto every part; separately targeting an unmodeled pin or seam does not create a cheap Sunder target. Missing a required implement can make a kit incomplete even with positive whole-item HP. Containers and surviving members retain real mass and location when Broken.

**NEW auxiliary bindings, not extra output families:** the existing **5-gp/5-lb Skinner’s-tools kit** can be recorded as knife 0.25 lb, bone saw 1.5 lb, scraper 1 lb and fitted protective roll/case 2.25 lb. Its saw is a sixteen-inch manual implement; its knife and scraper may use the K/H mundane profiles when they actually match. The roll stores those implements, not unrecorded specimen cargo. This decomposition adds no separate free tool, independent retail valuation or enchantment to the existing kit.

A default **mundane Harvesting Rack** is **6 gp, 25 lb, HP5/AC15**, with **48 × 30-inch supported work surface**, thirty-inch working height and **50-lb total supported load**. Packed envelope is **50 × 8 × 6 inches**; deployed outer envelope is **50 × 32 × 30 inches**. It requires stable placement. Setup or packing takes **five active minutes**, two hands, outside recipe active hours unless it was already properly deployed. No suspension of a larger corpse, lift rating, curing time, stasis or creature restraint follows. Other actual suitable existing stations can fulfill the requirement without a compulsory second purchase.

A tiered source **Curing rack** can serve the same station when its real geometry, condition and access suffice; it remains that exact source object. The new ordinary rack does not replace a 9,000-gp or 54,000-gp source occurrence merely because both are racks. Source values and flags stay intact.

## GT-S04 — Physical roles and separate procedures

**Affected: all five families. Sources: A1–A2 and C1; role predicates are NEW.**

| Family | Extraction role | Magical preservation-check scope |
|---|---|---|
| K | Controlled cutting/separation of actual compatible animal parts, with other necessary tools supplied | None |
| H | Separating/cleaning hide and physically compatible scale/chitin backing during the original extraction | None |
| R | Lifting/removing actual compatible scales or plates | None |
| T | Supporting and manually working actual hide or compatible scaled-sheet/backing extraction | Hide and compatible scales/chitin under GT-S09 |
| P | Actual controlled receiving/separation of supported animal parts during the original extraction; missing cutting tools remain required | Hide and compatible scales/chitin under GT-S09 |

A specialized candidate must support the **selected ordinary allocation for which an attempt-wide effect is claimed**, including its proposed reserve. H/R/T cannot turn an organ-only operation into their task. A compatible narrower selection must be declared before work with the actual partial-harvest consequences. A P box merely waiting beside someone else’s work, or a knife carried on a belt, contributes no magic.

A documented physically complete extraction assembly can satisfy that task’s tool requirement without being a second purchased full kit. Each necessary implement must actually exist. This does not waive creation/restoration’s specified tools or confer proficiency. P alone cannot cut an attached part merely because it can receive one; R does not supply a bone saw. None requires a portable rack for ordinary field extraction when A1’s stable accessible work surface and actual support suffice.

Identification remains A1’s **one-minute creature-type knowledge check**, using its actual INT/skill mapping except WIS/Medicine, with its own trained-assistant rule. Skinning item bonuses do not modify it. Unidentified but plainly recognizable selected categories can still be attempted with the existing disadvantage; missing hidden information is not invented. Unchanged-evidence identification retries remain prohibited.

**NEW deployment timing:** unfolding and supporting T takes one active minute; packing it takes one active minute. Opening and arranging P takes one Action/six seconds with both hands; closing and securing it takes the same. Necessary pre-check setup may be included in the governing extraction/treatment duration when the declared workflow actually fits; it never compresses the necessary work. Post-task packing is additional labor. A short attempt that cannot fit required setup and qualifying operation needs an already deployed arrangement or a different legal method. K/H/R use the ordinary actual item-access rules, not a new bonus activation. None supplies free retrieval, transport or station setup.

After extraction, hide fleshing, tanning, curing, leather conversion, food preparation and manufacturing are their own actual procedures. The existence of Tanning Tools does not author those processes or modify an already reviewed Leatherworking/Cooking recipe. Ordinary compatible physical assistance is distinct from the imprint’s check predicate.

**Specific name dispositions:** recipe-676’s “Pattern” produces the P body, not a free formula transcription, paper schema or whole-body harvest permission. Recipe-679’s “Frame” produces T at the stated finite dimensions, not a Mammoth-sized installation. Recipe-677 remains one R unit, despite “Set”; recipe-678 remains H, despite “Separator.” Preserve wholeCreatureUse=true on 676/677 and false on 678/679 without adding whole-corpse consumption, donor powers, extra ingredients or a same-individual requirement absent actual source text. Every listed component is still independently required.

## GT-S05 — One body, one selected finite ordinary harvest

**Affected: all extraction attempts. Sources: A1, A3; explicit Skinning reconciliation is NEW where stated.**

Before checks and selection, identify the **actual physical donor**, life/origin history, legal custody/access, ordinary manifest version, actual material units/masses, category allocations, damaged recoverable units, ordinary extra reserve, unique drops, unavailable parts, hazards, time/DC and receiving arrangement. Roll ordinary base yield once when the original manifest is made. Its ordinary units are shared across categories, not reproduced for each tool, worker or material name

The Mining verdict explicitly deferred Skinning’s omission triggers, body profiles and quality rules to this conference. The decisions below resolve that scope without promoting cards. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="0"}

# Skinning and shared gathering interfaces — GT-S source-authoring verdict

**Audience: internal conference record. Status: finite source/interface authoring directions, not exact operational-card approval.**

This verdict covers **all 43 Skinning originals: recipe-507–545 and recipe-676–679**, including all twelve numeric/prose omissions and all five physical families. The source allocation is **28 public, two restricted and thirteen Director-only**. **Zero cards are promoted.** Reviewed recipe totals remain **392/687, with 295 remaining; public 251/433, with 182 remaining**. All 128 gathering-tool cards remain pending exact review.

## Evidence, precedence and reconciliation

Evidence references below identify material supplied in this conference:

**A1:** Part A, `CRAFTING_HARVEST_PLAYTEST.md`: credentials, checks, finite manifests, size times/yields, partial forfeiture, preservation, crafting quality, material identity and dismantling. **A2:** Part A’s trade reference, equipment/body guides, Core task resolution and creature-lifecycle excerpts. **A3:** Part A’s completed Fishing guide, especially first-capture history, material chronology, actual custody and the harvest boundary. **B1:** Part B’s shared evidence, GT-01–32 and exact equipment/component references. **C1:** Part C’s complete COMMON/overrides and structural register. **C2:** Part C’s 28 complete six-paragraph public-book bindings. **M:** the preceding GT-M01–18 Mining source verdict.

C1 names mechanical source SHA-256 `32b2bf00c28584ad259c343bc5b961126d25078c094444c05bf3caf0c9edda5e`; C2 names book SHA-256 `38eac505991a944ea557afa27751f510f773744734dc7a8e84c52b9bf7dcb099`. These are supplied source identifiers, not hashes independently recomputed from those books in this response. Arithmetic below is derived from the supplied fields and the explicitly new body references; no local report is relabeled as an independent source-file, runtime or campaign-fact verification.

**No earlier GT-M decision is rescinded.** This verdict explicitly adopts the same bounded approaches to non-artisan credentials, ordered bodies, source-preserving discrepancies, independent effect comparisons and historical state. It does **not** import Mining’s sixty-minute node procedure, mineral units, deposit renewal or mineral-preparation attribute into carcass harvesting.

Three additions require explicit reconciliation rather than silent inheritance: **Skinning’s own critical-only extraYield1 overlay; a separate hide/scale preparation step; and a narrowly defined preservation-check scope for Tanning Tools/Preservation Kits.** GT-S09 also states a new default for untreated scales/chitin and its compatible mundane treatment. Those are Skinning authoring completions, not changes to Mining’s preservation exclusion. GT-S06 adds a finite cross-trade reserve-partition rule without reopening Fishing’s first evaluation.

Every **NEW** provision below is an authoring completion. Preserve every original source object, duplicate occurrence, absent/null field, legacy name/effect, resultItem value, source status, needsReview flag, discovery requirement, private guidance and book paragraph. Operational fields must state their provenance separately.

## GT-S01 — All printed effects and all twelve omissions

**Affected: all 43 Skinning recipes. Sources: C1–C2.**

| Group | Exact recipes | Printed bonus | Quality clause | Additional ordinary-part entitlement |
|---|---|---:|---|---|
| A | 507–531, 677, 678 | +1 Skinning | None | Zero |
| B | 532–541, 676, 679 | +2 Skinning | One successful hide/scale harvest quality step | **NEW:** up to one real eligible reserve unit, only on Critical Success |
| C | 542–545 | +3 Skinning | One successful hide/scale harvest quality step | Printed two additional usable parts, only on Critical Success |

The split is **27 A / 12 B / 4 C**. All recipe numbers in tables carry the `recipe-` prefix.

**Explicit individual omission dispositions:**

| Recipe | Visibility | Disposition of both original extraYield1 fields |
|---|---|---|
| 532 | restricted | Preserve; activate through NEW critical-only one-reserve-unit overlay |
| 533 | Director-only | Same explicit disposition |
| 534 | Director-only | Same explicit disposition |
| 535 | restricted | Same explicit disposition |
| 536 | Director-only | Same explicit disposition |
| 537 | Director-only | Same explicit disposition |
| 538 | Director-only | Same explicit disposition |
| 539 | Director-only | Same explicit disposition |
| 540 | Director-only | Same explicit disposition |
| 541 | Director-only | Same explicit disposition |
| 676 | public | Same explicit disposition, disclosed in its public operational text |
| 679 | Director-only | Same explicit disposition |

For each, retain the source prose that does **not** print yield. Do not claim it originally said “critical success.” This independently adopts the same bounded trigger selected for Mining, now after reviewing Skinning’s actual originals. An ordinary Success grants **no additional part** under either B or C. Failure/Critical Failure grants neither item yield nor item quality. All quality/extraYield clauses are **extraction-only**; a qualifying preservation check receives only its permitted numerical bonus.

**NEW interpretation:** the quality clause affects **one eligible ordinary hide/scale unit in one successful extraction attempt**, not every unit/category or all material from that species. It is reusable on other genuinely lawful, unresolved bodies, not a lifetime charge or a daily-use pool. The already-resolved body cannot be worked again to obtain another award.

The additional-part clause may recover an ordinary animal-part category other than hide/scale **only when the chosen Skinning procedure and actual tool role genuinely support it**. The quality step remains hide/scale-only. A specialized Scale Remover does not gain organ extraction from its ingredient list or from the generic word “parts.”

## GT-S02 — Credentials, tasks and effect arbitration

**Affected: all 43 recipes. Sources: A1–A2, M; Skinning-specific predicates below are NEW.**

Use **DEX or WIS**, chosen before the task, with the actual **non-artisan Skinner’s-tools credential**. Add PB once when trained, or the applicable replacing expertise contribution. Never add numerical trade level. **NEW ordinary-gathering binding:** untrained generic extraction uses no tool PB and has disadvantage; it has no recipe-level/formula gate. Actual tools, lawful access and physical possibility remain mandatory.

A novice may legitimately use a high-level finished tool under their own training terms; buying it gives no proficiency, formula, research result or creation eligibility. Artisan-only proficiency choices cannot select Skinner’s tools. Forge Dwarf’s artisan creation time/quality benefits apply to none of these Skinning creations or restoration tasks.

**Eligible magical check bonuses:** compatible ordinary animal-part extraction, including an independently authorized equivalent source procedure using Skinning; and **only T/P families** on the separately governed hide/compatible-scale preservation procedure in GT-S09. Physical roles and work windows must qualify.

**Excluded:** creature-type identification, Medicine diagnosis/treatment, knowledge checks, hunting/capture, recipe creation, formula research/copying, repair/reconstruction, leather/armor manufacture, tanning as a manufacturing process, post-harvest surface preparation, dismantling, valuation, combat and general Forage. Tool ownership or a task’s name supplies no exception. The source crafting specialty remains crafting-work-order scoped.

**NEW Skinning-only comparison families:** `equipment.skinning-task-enhancement` uses the strongest independently eligible Skinning recipe bonus once; `equipment.skinning-extra-recovery` uses the strongest eligible critical-only allowance once; `equipment.skinning-quality-step` permits at most one eligible step on one unit. These are three independent comparisons, not three additive item totals or a universal strongest-modifier rule.

An extraction lead may have **one trained eligible assistant for +1**, working the same required extraction time. The assistant’s tool magic does not become the lead’s bonus or extra yield, and their hands do not substitute for the lead’s. Preservation has **no assistants**, as retained in A1. Creation uses each recipe’s separate assistant cap.

Actual class, spell, facility and other item modifiers must meet their own reviewed predicates and stacking rules. Do not infer a Leatherworking, Tailoring, Fishing or jewel bonus from a shared word. Do not silently move a competing effect to a new family. A genuinely unprovided source interaction remains for the final joint source check, not an invented universal rule.

## GT-S03 — Five complete physical output models

**Affected: exact family sets below. All body prices, dimensions and internal contents are NEW except the explicitly reused Small-knife value/mass.**

Every output is a **durable magical nonartifact tool**, Standard equipment grade, without attunement, RP, charges, concentration or separate magic-activation Action. There is no automatic Large scaling. Real hands, fit, weight, space, support and tissue/material compatibility still govern.

| Code / family | Exact recipes | Mundane body gp / empty lb | Ordinary HP / structural AC |
|---|---|---|---|
| K — Skinning Knife | 508, 514, 521, 522, 528, 530, 533, 536, 538 | **1 gp / 0.25 lb** | 5 / 19 |
| H — Hide Scraper | 510, 511, 515, 518, 523, 525, 526, 531, 532, 537, 541, 544, 678 | **1 gp / 1 lb** | 5 / 19 |
| R — Scale Remover | 513, 517, 519, 534, 535, 540, 543, 545, 677 | **2 gp / 1 lb** | 5 / 19 |
| T — Tanning Tools | 507, 512, 520, 524, 539, 542, 679 | **8 gp / 8 lb** | 5 / 15 |
| P — Preservation Kit | 509, 516, 527, 529, 676 | **10 gp / 6 lb** | 5 / 19 |

**K:** an eight-inch tool with four-inch steel blade, continuous tang and fitted grip. Reuse the reviewed Small knife’s 1-gp/0.25-lb reference only for a physically matching specimen; the skinning shape is a NEW binding. One hand manipulates it and the other controls the supported work. Original blade/tang is primary; a compatible grip may be replaced. No sheath or sample container is included. It is not automatically a dagger, magical weapon or surgical permission.

**H:** a twelve-inch two-hand scraper with a four-inch steel working edge/bar and two grips. Both hands operate it on an actual supported hide or compatible plate/backing. Original steel working bar/blade is primary; grips and minor fittings may be replaced. It provides no rack, sample storage, force multiplier or automatic ability to separate an incompatible carapace.

**R:** a ten-by-two-by-one-inch guarded manual rake/lifter, with steel working head/spine and grip. One hand operates it and the other steadies the supported specimen. Original head/spine is primary; grip and minor fittings may be replaced. It lifts compatible scales/plates along actually separable attachments. It is not a drill, universal shell opener, net, weapon, restraint or container.

**T:** a folding manual frame, **26 × 26 × 4 inches deployed**, **26 × 4 × 4 inches packed**, with a **24 × 24-inch clear supported work area**. Maximum supported workpiece/consumable load: **10 lb**, with actual thickness up to **2 inches** where retained in the frame. No compression is granted. Contents: frame rails/crossbars 4 lb, draw scraper 1 lb, blunt slicker 0.5 lb, four clamps 1 lb total, support straps/feet 1 lb and fitted roll 0.5 lb: **8 lb total**.

T needs actual stable support and two manipulating hands. It supports controlled hide/backing separation and preparation; a compatible sheet of scales/chitin can qualify through its actual physical method. It is not a vat, full-body hoist, preservation effect, tent or automatically supplied Harvesting Rack. Original frame rails/crossbars and draw-scraper working blade are primary. Compatible clamps, straps, grips, slicker and roll are replaceable ordinary members; the complete required set must still exist for magical function. A frame’s ten-pound limit never admits a whole Mammoth by name.

**P:** a lidded steel receiving/treatment box, **16 × 10 × 6 inches outside**, with a dedicated **12 × 8 × 4-inch specimen chamber** and separate fitted implement wells. Chamber contents must satisfy **10 lb and 0.20 ft³**, actual shape, closure and material compatibility. Empty contents: box/lid 4 lb, tongs 0.5 lb, spreading spatula 0.5 lb, brush 0.25 lb, measuring scoop 0.25 lb, reusable liner 0.5 lb: **6 lb total**.

P supports hands-on receiving, controlled separation with its implements where appropriate, and treatment of already lawfully removed parts. Both hands are committed to its nominated work. The original box shell/lid and tongs are primary; spatula, brush, scoop, liner and minor closures may be replaced compatibly. It supplies no knife, bone saw, salt, oil, clean-water allotment, fresh packing, fuel, refrigeration or magical containment. Its box alone does not pause decay. Larger actual receiving containers can support a compatible workflow, but do not enlarge this box or eliminate its required actual use.

Steel load-bearing models use structural AC19; T’s wooden frame uses AC15. A separately modeled constituent retains its actual material defenses. Whole-item HP is not cloned onto every part; separately targeting an unmodeled pin or seam does not create a cheap Sunder target. Missing a required implement can make a kit incomplete even with positive whole-item HP. Containers and surviving members retain real mass and location when Broken.

**NEW auxiliary bindings, not extra output families:** the existing **5-gp/5-lb Skinner’s-tools kit** can be recorded as knife 0.25 lb, bone saw 1.5 lb, scraper 1 lb and fitted protective roll/case 2.25 lb. Its saw is a sixteen-inch manual implement; its knife and scraper may use the K/H mundane profiles when they actually match. The roll stores those implements, not unrecorded specimen cargo. This decomposition adds no separate free tool, independent retail valuation or enchantment to the existing kit.

A default **mundane Harvesting Rack** is **6 gp, 25 lb, HP5/AC15**, with **48 × 30-inch supported work surface**, thirty-inch working height and **50-lb total supported load**. Packed envelope is **50 × 8 × 6 inches**; deployed outer envelope is **50 × 32 × 30 inches**. It requires stable placement. Setup or packing takes **five active minutes**, two hands, outside recipe active hours unless it was already properly deployed. No suspension of a larger corpse, lift rating, curing time, stasis or creature restraint follows. Other actual suitable existing stations can fulfill the requirement without a compulsory second purchase.

A tiered source **Curing rack** can serve the same station when its real geometry, condition and access suffice; it remains that exact source object. The new ordinary rack does not replace a 9,000-gp or 54,000-gp source occurrence merely because both are racks. Source values and flags stay intact.

## GT-S04 — Physical roles and separate procedures

**Affected: all five families. Sources: A1–A2 and C1; role predicates are NEW.**

| Family | Extraction role | Magical preservation-check scope |
|---|---|---|
| K | Controlled cutting/separation of actual compatible animal parts, with other necessary tools supplied | None |
| H | Separating/cleaning hide and physically compatible scale/chitin backing during the original extraction | None |
| R | Lifting/removing actual compatible scales or plates | None |
| T | Supporting and manually working actual hide or compatible scaled-sheet/backing extraction | Hide and compatible scales/chitin under GT-S09 |
| P | Actual controlled receiving/separation of supported animal parts during the original extraction; missing cutting tools remain required | Hide and compatible scales/chitin under GT-S09 |

A specialized candidate must support the **selected ordinary allocation for which an attempt-wide effect is claimed**, including its proposed reserve. H/R/T cannot turn an organ-only operation into their task. A compatible narrower selection must be declared before work with the actual partial-harvest consequences. A P box merely waiting beside someone else’s work, or a knife carried on a belt, contributes no magic.

A documented physically complete extraction assembly can satisfy that task’s tool requirement without being a second purchased full kit. Each necessary implement must actually exist. This does not waive creation/restoration’s specified tools or confer proficiency. P alone cannot cut an attached part merely because it can receive one; R does not supply a bone saw. None requires a portable rack for ordinary field extraction when A1’s stable accessible work surface and actual support suffice.

Identification remains A1’s **one-minute creature-type knowledge check**, using its actual INT/skill mapping except WIS/Medicine, with its own trained-assistant rule. Skinning item bonuses do not modify it. Unidentified but plainly recognizable selected categories can still be attempted with the existing disadvantage; missing hidden information is not invented. Unchanged-evidence identification retries remain prohibited.

**NEW deployment timing:** unfolding and supporting T takes one active minute; packing it takes one active minute. Opening and arranging P takes one Action/six seconds with both hands; closing and securing it takes the same. Necessary pre-check setup may be included in the governing extraction/treatment duration when the declared workflow actually fits; it never compresses the necessary work. Post-task packing is additional labor. A short attempt that cannot fit required setup and qualifying operation needs an already deployed arrangement or a different legal method. K/H/R use the ordinary actual item-access rules, not a new bonus activation. None supplies free retrieval, transport or station setup.

After extraction, hide fleshing, tanning, curing, leather conversion, food preparation and manufacturing are their own actual procedures. The existence of Tanning Tools does not author those processes or modify an already reviewed Leatherworking/Cooking recipe. Ordinary compatible physical assistance is distinct from the imprint’s check predicate.

**Specific name dispositions:** recipe-676’s “Pattern” produces the P body, not a free formula transcription, paper schema or whole-body harvest permission. Recipe-679’s “Frame” produces T at the stated finite dimensions, not a Mammoth-sized installation. Recipe-677 remains one R unit, despite “Set”; recipe-678 remains H, despite “Separator.” Preserve wholeCreatureUse=true on 676/677 and false on 678/679 without adding whole-corpse consumption, donor powers, extra ingredients or a same-individual requirement absent actual source text. Every listed component is still independently required.

## GT-S05 — One body, one selected finite ordinary harvest

**Affected: all extraction attempts. Sources: A1, A3; explicit Skinning reconciliation is NEW where stated.**

Before checks and selection, identify the **actual physical donor**, life/origin history, legal custody/access, ordinary manifest version, actual material units/masses, category allocations, damaged recoverable units, ordinary extra reserve, unique drops, unavailable parts, hazards, time/DC and receiving arrangement. Roll ordinary base yield once when the original manifest is made. Its ordinary units are shared across categories, not reproduced for each tool, worker or material name
